# Source Code

#### Course: Learn Recursion with JavaScript

## Source Code

```javascript
1function calculateSum(n) {
2
3    if (n === 1) {
4        return 1;
5    }
6    
7    // Add n to the return value of recursive call
8    return n + calculateSum(n - 1);
9}
10
11let result = calculateSum(3);
12console.log(result);
13
14// Output: 6
```
